versions.changelog: v1.1.1: corrected display name; includes moe teaching standards + occupation dictionary + xlsx maps (~3.9MB, within ClawHub 5MB payload limit). ESCO/O*NET detail docs excluded from package (see GitHub flyboat403/occupation-analysis for full data).

Initial release of the occupation-analysis skill.

- Generates structured vocational analysis reports for Chinese vocational education (secondary, higher, and undergraduate).
- Supports user scenarios including professional name/code input, explicit requests for vocational/task analysis, action domain division, learning field conversion, and learning scenario design.
- Ensures use of authoritative data sources (Chinese Occupational Dictionary, ESCO, O*NET) with clear data handling and validation steps.
- Enforces process integrity with mandatory user confirmation and pre-execution validation.
- Outputs both Markdown and Word format reports.
- Provides robust error and edge case handling, with strict adherence to education level specificity and professional standards.
